$comment: Per-client SCHEDULED EXECUTION contract for Eco Driving mailing datasets.
Read by jobs/ecodriving/scheduled_mailing_contract.py, and ONLY for a fire
the Workflow A dispatcher has already claimed. Nothing here causes a fire.
WHAT AN ENTRY DECLARES
Exactly one thing: the execution_mode a scheduled fire of that dataset
for that client must use. It is the same explicit parameter an operator
types by hand, resolved by the same jobs.ecodriving.email_safety code, so
a scheduled run and a manual run are the same invocation.
WHAT AN ENTRY DOES NOT DECLARE
* WHETHER the schedule fires at all, and WHEN. Cadence, weekday, run_time,
business timezone and the enabled/disabled switch live in
workflow_a_control.client_dataset_schedule and nowhere else. An entry
here against a disabled schedule row sends nothing, ever.
* WHETHER the e-mail carries a Driver Eco Dashboard. That permission is
declared once, in ops/eco_dashboard_mailing_rollout.json, and this file
holds no dashboard switch of its own. A scheduled fire of a declared
entry carries the runner's --with-dashboard option when, and only when,
that rollout declaration enables the client; the job then re-checks the
same permission itself before it publishes anything or opens SMTP.
SCHEDULABLE MODES
normal_send - the production send.
render_only - renders and sends nothing; the safe rehearsal.
test_send and force_resend are NOT schedulable. test_send needs a
human-chosen recipient and force_resend deliberately overrides an
established send: neither is a decision a timer may take.
FAIL CLOSED
A (client, dataset) pair that is not named here is not scheduled
production: its fire carries no execution_mode and the job's own default
applies - render only, no mail, no dashboard. New and unknown clients
therefore never inherit a production schedule. A wildcard is refused as a
malformed declaration, so "all clients" is not expressible.
CURRENT OWNER DECISION
BRAVO00016 weekly - scheduled production sending declared as normal_send.
Dashboard resolves to ENABLED through the rollout
declaration. The schedule row itself is still DISABLED, so
this declaration sends nothing by itself; enabling the first
production schedule is a separate, separately authorized
owner decision on the timetable.
BRAVO00016 monthly - NOT declared. Monthly mailing is a separate owner
decision and is not part of this rollout.

schedules.note: Weekly EcoDriving Person production mailing. Period is selected automatically as the latest closed, finalized weekly snapshot in Europe/Warsaw.
